title: Uncollapsed Panel Styling Bug
description: ui: There is a bug when clicking on e.g. the left window panel then when it uncollapses the toggle is cut and has wrong styling.
summary: Fix panel tab clipping on lower levels: (1) replace browser default outline (clipped by overflow-x:auto implicit overflow-y:hidden) with outline-none + focus-visible:ring-inset so focus rings never overflow the scroll container; (2) remove rounded-sm from panelTabButtonClass — rounded corners created 2px transparent pixels at button edges that exposed the chrome frame border (z-30) behind the active bg fill (z-40), appearing as a cut.
